_comments: Sets JSONType metadata on Task.Configuration (MJ: Tasks entity) so CodeGen emits a typed
A Task row IS a workflow step once a workflow is compiled onto the dispatcher. StepType and the
Agent/Action/Prompt/User keys are real columns because SQL routes on them; everything else about
a step — the loop definition, the payload mappings, the execution policy — lives in this bag, so
a new step kind or policy knob is a JSONType edit rather than another migration.
ORDERING: the EntityField row for Task.Configuration is created by CodeGen's database pass over
the new column, so this @lookup cannot resolve until that has run. The sequence is
mj migrate -> mj codegen --skipfiles -> mj sync push -> mj codegen --skipdb.
Pushing before the first CodeGen fails with 'No record found in MJ: Entity Fields'.
Configuration field — everything about a workflow step that has no column of its own
